hypotheses.justification: Split on whether referenceFrequency D j is zero. The nonzero case uses the existing proof. In the zero case, referencePressure vanishes because copyPressure divides by that frequency. Also normalWeight is zero, so the transported normal is zero; TangentProjection.pressureCoefficient then has zero denominator and is zero. Thus bandPressure also vanishes. Unfolding complexCopyPressure, commonPressure, periodizedCopies and mode reduces both sides to zero.

Its only uses are through cylinderChange_graph, whose identity holds for every real radius. Strengthen commonGraph_radialScale using (a*r)^b = a^b*r^b for a > 0 and arbitrary r: for r ≥ 0 use Real.mul_rpow; for r < 0 use Real.rpow_def_of_neg, Real.rpow_def_of_pos, Real.log_mul and exponential addition. The nonnegative case includes r = 0, even when b = 0. The existing proofs of commonGraph_map and cylinderChange_graph then work without radius positivity, and the rest of this proof is unchanged.
